# Paolo Marocco — Neural Models · Visual Storytelling

> Personal site of Paolo Marocco: mathematician and PhD in Economics, former
> secondary-school teacher, former professional film critic (two books, on
> Eric Rohmer and on Hitchcock's Vertigo), now building AI-assisted
> visual-storytelling pipelines (ComfyUI) and a Dynamic Creative
> Optimization (DCO) engine for brand campaigns, plus quantitative tools
> for Italian film-industry analysis.

## Core pages

- [About](https://storyline-engine.com/about): who Paolo is and his background.
- [Posts](https://storyline-engine.com/posts): index of all posts on this site.
- [ADV](https://storyline-engine.com/adv): Dynamic Creative Optimization for brand campaigns.
- [ComfyUI](https://storyline-engine.com/comfyui): overview of the node-based generative-AI tool.
- [Visual Stories / Storyboards](https://storyline-engine.com/neural-graphics): AI-made visual narrative for comics and storyboards.
- [Film Forecast](https://storyline-engine.com/neural-forecast): quantitative tools for the Italian film industry.
